messages.content: 如果我從紐約出發，途經費城、華盛頓特區和亞特蘭大，最後抵達邁阿密，預計的旅行時間會是多少？另外，如果我不停留在亞特蘭大，直接從華盛頓特區前往邁阿密，會是多少時間？最後，如果我從改成從費城出發，停留華盛頓特區，然後抵達邁阿密，會是多少時間？

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function route_estimate_time with appropriate parameters. The function signature: start_location: string, end_location: string, stops?: string[].

We have three queries:

1. From New York (NYC) through Philadelphia, Washington DC, Atlanta, to Miami. So start_location "New York", stops ["Philadelphia","Washington DC","Atlanta"], end_location "Miami".

2. If no stop in Atlanta, directly from Washington DC to Miami. So start_location "New York", stops ["Philadelphia","Washington DC"], end_location "Miami". Wait the user says "directly from Washington DC to Miami" but still passes through Philadelphia? They said "if I don't stop in Atlanta, directly from Washington DC to Miami". That implies we still pass through Philadelphia? Actually they say "directly from Washington DC to Miami" meaning skip Atlanta. But do we still include Philadelphia? The phrase "directly from Washington DC to Miami" might mean after Washington DC, go straight to Miami, skipping Atlanta. But still includes Philadelphia? The original route was NYC -> Philadelphia -> Washington DC -> Atlanta -> Miami. If we skip Atlanta, we would go NYC -> Philadelphia -> Washington DC -> Miami. So stops ["Philadelphia","Washington DC"].

3. Starting from Philadelphia, stop at Washington DC, then reach Miami. So start_location "Philadelphia", stops ["Washington DC"], end_location "Miami".

We need to call the function for each scenario. The function returns any; presumably it will return estimated travel time. We need to output the results. We'll call the function thrice. Use the function tool.
